# Filter widget rendering notes
<div class="content-body">
The filter field&nbsp;supports status=active in the rendered widget.<br/>
　FAQ: Why does the chart type dropdown keep a stale value?<br />
Because&nbsp;the cached filter predicate is not invalidated&nbsp;on rerender.
<span style="color:#333">Error E_RENDER_31: residual markup in the payload.</span>
<p>Parameter debounce_ms:&nbsp;integer, default&nbsp;250.</p>
　See <a href="https://design.example/render">https://design.example/render</a> for details.
</div>
